fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s winter economy and tourism (including competition with Havana and the loss of horse racing), advertising practices and high-pressure sales, and civic conditions such as street lighting and transit service. Reports and columns discuss court and legal matters (including a libel case involving Tom Arnold), grand jury findings on Dade County expenditures, and public health concerns (meat grinding sanitation). Additional content covers Florida egg grading legislation and increased production, promotional material on the Tamiami Trail and regional development, and assorted society/campus notes and advertisements.
